description: Use when the user gives several Steam ids - a match roster, a team, a list of suspects - and wants profiles, FACEIT or ban status for all of them: up to 100 in ONE call, always instead of per-player calls. ids are STRINGS in any computable SteamID format (steamid64, STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a /profiles/ link); never JSON numbers (a 17-digit number loses precision and points at another account); vanity names are not accepted - resolve them with steam_identity first. Players unknown to the platform come back in not_found - fetch those with steam_profile. include adds FACEIT (one query for the batch) and Steam bans (one upstream call) - the cheapest way to review a full roster. Do not use for one player (steam_summary).

ids.description: steamid64 list, max 100 - prefer one batch over per-player calls

include.description: extra blocks per player: faceit level/ELO, Steam ban status

name: steam_batch

invalid.description: inputs that are not a computable SteamID

not_found.description: valid ids unknown to the platform - fetch them with steam_profile

players.description: per player: steamid64, ids, steam and the include blocks
